data.name: Wooden Wedding Couple Cake Topper
data.description:
About Wooden Wedding Couple Cake Topper – Romantic Wedding Décor

Add a beautiful and romantic finishing touch to your special celebration with this Wooden Wedding Couple Cake Topper. Designed with an elegant bride and groom silhouette, the intricate laser-cut detailing captures a memorable wedding moment and makes your cake stand out beautifully.

Crafted from quality wood with a natural finish, this lightweight topper can be easily placed on wedding and celebration cakes. Its timeless design complements traditional, rustic, minimalist and modern wedding themes.

Perfect for weddings, engagements, receptions, anniversaries and bridal celebrations, this wooden cake topper can also be preserved after the event as a meaningful keepsake of your special day.

Build Quality

Crafted from quality wood with precise laser cutting and detailed engraving. The lightweight yet sturdy construction makes it easy to place on cakes while maintaining its shape and elegant appearance.

Design Highlights

Features a beautifully detailed bride and groom silhouette in a romantic wedding pose. Fine engraved lines highlight the couple’s outfits, hair and facial details, giving the topper an artistic handcrafted appearance. The natural wooden finish adds a warm and elegant touch.

Perfect Spaces

Perfect for wedding cakes, engagement cakes, reception décor, anniversary celebrations, bridal events and wedding dessert tables. It also works beautifully with rustic, traditional and minimalist wedding themes.

Gifting & Personalisation

A charming addition to wedding celebrations and a memorable keepsake for couples. Personalisation options such as couple names, wedding date or a short message can be incorporated depending on the chosen design.

Looking After Your Piece

Handle gently, especially around the finely cut areas. Keep away from water and excessive moisture. After use, wipe carefully with a clean, dry cloth and store flat in a dry place if you wish to preserve it as a keepsake.

Quick Highlights

  • Product: Wooden Wedding Couple Cake Topper

  • Material: Wood

  • Design: Bride & Groom Silhouette

  • Height: Approx. 13 cm

  • Length: Approx. 10 cm

  • Finish: Natural Wooden Finish

  • Style: Romantic & Elegant

  • Detailing: Laser-Cut & Engraved

  • Suitable For: Wedding, Engagement, Reception & Anniversary Cakes

  • Personalisation: Available

  • Reusable: Can be preserved as a wedding keepsake
